title: Crepes with Peanut Filling
description: Delicate French crepes filled with a rich peanut filling, perfect for a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: French crepes
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade crepes work well for this recipe.

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together peanut butter, sugar, and milk until smooth.
Add a pinch of salt and mix until combined.
Lay a crepe flat on a work surface and spoon about 1-2 tablespoons of the peanut filling onto the center of the crepe.
Fold the crepe in half over the filling, then fold in half again to form a triangle.
To make homemade crepes, whisk together 1 cup of milk, 1 large egg, and 1 tablespoon of melted butter in a bowl.
Add 1 1/2 cups of all-purpose flour and whisk until smooth.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with melted butter.
Pour a small amount of the batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the crepe with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, until the other side is lightly browned.
